{'text': '葉家駒批相關部門「因循苟且，閃得就閃」', 'target': "Yip Ka-kui criticizes relevant departments for being 'complacent and evasive'"}

{'text': '宏福苑獨立委員會為期30日的聽證會結束，政府及獨立委員會昨日、今日已發表總結陳詞，政府將部門的表現形容為「系統性弱點」，在大火中喪妻的宏泰閣居民葉家駒表示，情緒有些波動，自己也始料不及。他認為真相仍未水落石出，批評政府昨日的陳詞「接近冷血、冷冰冰，沒感情」，是一份只為推卸責任的陳詞。', 'target': "The 30-day hearing of the Wang Fuk Court independent committee has concluded. The government and the independent committee delivered their closing submissions yesterday and today. The government described the performance of the departments as exhibiting 'systemic weaknesses.' Yip Ka-kui, a resident of Wang Tai House who lost his wife in the fire, said his emotions have been somewhat fluctuating, something he did not expect. He believes the truth has not yet come to light and criticized the government's submission yesterday as 'bordering on cold-blooded, icy cold, and devoid of emotion,' a submission made solely to shirk responsibility."}

{'text': '他表示，政府的陳詞反映，面對大災難，所有相關涉事政府部門，並未汲取教訓，也不覺得應該汲取教訓。「係一個咁大災難下，佢哋都唔可以大刀闊斧，將陋習連根拔起，依然因循苟且，閃得就閃，避得就避，如果整個政府結構有呢種心態，我唔覺得佢有得改，或者會改得好」。', 'target': "He said the government's submission reflects that, in the face of a major disaster, all relevant government departments involved have not learned any lessons, nor do they feel they should learn any. 'In the face of such a major disaster, they still cannot take bold measures to uproot malpractices. They remain complacent, evading whenever possible, avoiding whenever they can. If the entire government structure has this kind of mindset, I don't think it can change, or will change for the better.'"}

{'text': '他表示，真正負責任的政府，應該知道怎樣負責任。「每個部門，都喺呢個拼圖上打咗自己嘅一塊落去」。', 'target': "He said a truly responsible government should know how to take responsibility. 'Every department has put its own piece into this puzzle.'"}

{'text': '遺屬李國鴻：矛頭只指向宏業、鴻毅，部門個個卸膊', 'target': 'Bereaved family member Lee Kwok-hung: The blame is only directed at Wang Yip and Hung Ngai, while every department is shirking responsibility'}

{'text': '於火災中喪母、兩名家傭罹難的另一位證人李國鴻總結指，聽證會矛頭只指向宏業、鴻毅，「政府部門個個都卸膊」。針對市建局代表於周三陳詞指部門不能百分百取締圍標，李國鴻斥責，居民於大火前向市建局以至多個部門投訴均無結果，事後才推出「加強版招標妥」改善，做法令人質疑：「你唔知（有問題）我話畀你聽，咁你唔理，你個制度再重啲都無用啦！你整到幾好都無用。」', 'target': "Another witness, Lee Kwok-hung, who lost his mother and two domestic helpers in the fire, summarized that the hearing only pointed the finger at Wang Yip and Hung Ngai, while 'every government department is shirking responsibility.' Regarding the URA representative's submission on Wednesday stating that departments cannot completely eradicate bid-rigging, Lee rebuked that residents had complained to the URA and multiple departments before the fire without result, and it was only afterwards that the 'enhanced ASP' was introduced to make improvements, a practice that raises doubts: 'You didn't know (there was a problem), I told you, but you ignored it. No matter how strict your system is, it's useless! No matter how well you do it, it's useless.'"}

{'text': '他續嘲諷，「如果你（有人）處理，使咩加強？你唔知咩？」聽證會上，政府部門指自己受人所騙，李國鴻亦不接受此說法，指「如果你咁都畀人呃，你應該辭職唔好做」。', 'target': "He continued mockingly, 'If you (someone) had handled it, why would you need to enhance it? Didn't you know?' At the hearing, government departments claimed they were deceived. Lee also does not accept this argument, stating, 'If you were deceived like that, you should resign and not do the job.'"}

{'text': '「唔通我哋環境係最理想咩？」', 'target': "'Is our environment ideal?'"}

{'text': '未曾缺席的宏盛閣居民羅先生指，打從首場聽證會開案陳詞起，已感到「有好多嘢係唔應該發生」，如部門多走一步，相信大火不會發生；乃至後來不同部門作供時稱情況「唔理想」，他反問：「唔通我哋環境係最理想咩？」', 'target': "Mr. Lo, a resident of Wang Shing House who has never missed a session, said that since the opening statement at the first hearing, he had felt that 'many things should not have happened.' If the departments had taken one more step, he believes the fire would not have occurred. When different departments later testified that the situation was 'not ideal,' he retorted, 'Is our environment ideal?'"}

{'text': '30日的聽證會，他認為委員會的作用是冀望找到真相，對於事件全貌，羅先生諷稱：「我點知有咩我要發掘嘅嘢？發掘嘅嘢就係，最無辜就係宏福苑嘅災民。」', 'target': "Regarding the 30-day hearing, he believes the committee's role is to find the truth. As for the full picture of the incident, Mr. Lo sarcastically remarked, 'How would I know what I need to uncover? What is uncovered is that the most innocent are the victims of Wang Fuk Court.'"}

{'text': '羅先生：我可以有咩期望？', 'target': 'Mr. Lo: What can I expect?'}

{'text': '相比有街坊喪親，羅先生指一家尚幸安全，但至今最大感受是「無辜囉，最無辜就係宏福苑災民，我哋唔係想有咁嘅結果，𠵱家我哋嚟講，家園盡毁。」被問及對未來報告出爐有何期望，他只道：「我可以希望啲咩？我可以有咩期望？希望、期望就係政府𠵱家安頓我哋災民，做返好少少。」', 'target': "Compared to neighbors who lost family members, Mr. Lo said his family was fortunately safe, but his biggest feeling to date is, 'We're innocent, the most innocent are the victims of Wang Fuk Court. We didn't want this result. Now, for us, our home is completely destroyed.' Asked about his expectations for the upcoming report, he only said, 'What can I hope for? What can I expect? My hope and expectation is that the government will resettle us victims now, and do a little better.'"}

{'text': '回應政府責任\u3000梁浩軒：無可能就咁話係受害者就唔關事', 'target': 'Responding to government responsibility, Leung Ho-hin: It is impossible to just say we are victims and have nothing to do with it'}

{'text': '聽畢六輪共30場聽證會、並曾任證人的宏盛閣居民梁浩軒指，聽證會後「一路都仲有好長嘅路要行落去」，包括將於周日舉行的業主大會，他必會出席，但他指合安至今仍未通知他與會地點。他苦笑，聽證會告終後唯一感受，是之後毋需再出席聽證。', 'target': "Leung Ho-hin, a resident of Wang Shing House who attended all six rounds of 30 hearings and previously served as a witness, said that after the hearing, 'there is still a long road ahead,' including the owners' meeting to be held on Sunday, which he will definitely attend. However, he said Hop On has yet to notify him of the venue. He said with a bitter smile that after the hearing concludes, his only feeling is that he no longer has to attend hearings."}

{'text': '政府代表、資深大律師孫靖乾昨日在總結陳詞中力陳，政府受承建商所騙，對外界指責政府為大火始作俑者，孫指並不公允。委員會代表、資深大律師杜淦堃今日則點出房屋局ICU、屋宇署、消防處、勞工處等四個部門的監管責任。', 'target': "Government representative and Senior Counsel Jonathan Man SC strongly argued in his closing submission yesterday that the government was deceived by the contractor and that it was unfair for outsiders to accuse the government of being the mastermind behind the fire. Committee representative and Senior Counsel Stewart K K To SC today pointed out the supervisory responsibility of four departments: the Housing Bureau's ICU, the Buildings Department, the Fire Services Department, and the Labour Department."}

{'text': '梁浩軒今重申，無法理解政府說法，指政府作為監督者，「或者generally嚟講、你係負責服務我哋全香港700萬市民嘅一個角色，無可能就咁一句話『其實我哋都係受害者就唔關我哋事』」。', 'target': "Leung Ho-hin reiterated today that he cannot understand the government's argument, pointing out that as a supervisor, 'or generally speaking, you are a role responsible for serving all 7 million Hong Kong citizens. It is impossible to just say, 'Actually, we are also victims, so it has nothing to do with us'.'"}

{'text': '委員會今結案時，亦揭示了區議員黃碧嬌分別在兩次業主大會收取逾兩成授權票。梁浩軒認為，即使屋苑大維修以至火災並非直接因她而起，「佢至少都要出嚟評論吓、關心吓我哋啦？但係我相信到𠵱家仲未有人感受到嚟自佢嘅關心。」至於有人拒絕作供，梁浩軒認為這些人的缺席，正正是令部分事實缺失、未能呈現；他個人亦期望聽證會完結後，執法部門可以加快行動，檢控涉事單位。', 'target': "When the committee concluded its case today, it also revealed that district councillor Wong Bik-kiu collected over 20% of proxy votes at two owners' meetings respectively. Leung Ho-hin believes that even though the major maintenance of the estate and the fire were not directly caused by her, 'she should at least come out to comment and show some concern for us? But I believe no one has yet felt any concern from her.' As for those who refused to testify, Leung Ho-hin believes that their absence is precisely what causes some facts to be missing and not presented. He personally also hopes that after the hearing, law enforcement agencies can expedite action and prosecute the entities involved."}

{'text': '宏盛閣廖先生：未見官員道歉難釋懷', 'target': 'Mr. Liu of Wang Shing House: Hard to find closure without any official apology'}

{'text': '宏盛閣居民廖先生指，大火發生至聽證會完結期間，發生了很多事，心情仍未平伏，甚至今日再聽陳詞情緒仍會波動，「其實係辛苦」。然而即使聽證會完結，他同樣認為，聽證會後仍要面對很多法律程序，期望最終可還原真相，讓宏福苑居民「有返個公義」，目前亦至少了解事件成因，惟責任有待釐清。', 'target': "Mr. Liu, a resident of Wang Shing House, said that many things happened between the fire and the conclusion of the hearing, and his emotions have not yet settled. Even today, listening to the submissions again still causes emotional fluctuations. 'It is actually tough.' However, even though the hearing has concluded, he also believes that many legal procedures still have to be faced after the hearing. He hopes the truth can ultimately be restored and let the residents of Wang Fuk Court 'have some justice.' At present, they at least understand the cause of the incident, but responsibility remains to be clarified."}

{'text': '就政府權責而言，他認為政府在事件中作為監督方，不應只將責任推卸到兩間公司。他又指，至今未有任何官員在公開場合就事件道歉或慰問，自己尚未釋懷，「可能有人道歉，會放低返一部分，起碼叫做原來政府係關心市民，不論係宏福苑居民又好，市民大眾又好，原來政府喺發生咗一啲重大災難後有出嚟慰問吓市民，我相信⋯⋯會幫一部分市民、居民有釋懷嘅感覺。」惟廖先生亦坦言，對官員問責並無信心。', 'target': "As for the government's responsibility, he believes that as a supervisor in the incident, the government should not simply shift all responsibility to the two companies. He also pointed out that no official has yet apologized or expressed condolences in public over the incident, and he has not found closure. 'If someone apologizes, it might ease part of the burden. At least it would show that the government cares about citizens. Whether it is the residents of Wang Fuk Court or the general public, if the government came out to comfort citizens after a major disaster, I believe... it would help some citizens and residents feel a sense of closure.' However, Mr. Liu also frankly stated that he has no confidence in holding officials accountable."}

{'text': '聽證會告一段落，但由合安舉行的業主大會緊接於周日舉行；惟業主如欲出席，需要填妥表格後，經由合安抽出大埔、啟德、天水圍、南區其中一個地點。梁浩軒表示定必出席，但至今仍未獲合安通知所獲分配的地點。', 'target': "The hearing has come to an end, but the owners' meeting organized by Hop On will be held immediately on Sunday. However, owners wishing to attend must fill out a form, after which Hop On will assign one of four venues: Tai Po, Kai Tak, Tin Shui Wai, or Southern District. Leung Ho-hin said he will definitely attend, but has yet to be notified by Hop On of his assigned venue."}

{'text': '宏盛閣居民何小姐同樣指未收到合安通知，「（合安）好奇怪，佢話好難搵業主，但其實佢係搵到㗎喎，因為佢都識寄大會流程俾我哋。佢係搵到業主個地址去寄，就算住喺過渡性房屋，佢都識搵。」', 'target': "Ms. Ho, a resident of Wang Shing House, also said she had not received any notification from Hop On. '(Hop On) is very strange. They said it's hard to find owners, but actually they can find them, because they know how to send us the meeting procedures. They can find the owners' addresses to send mail. Even if they live in transitional housing, they can find them.'"}

{'text': '何小姐又認為，合安召開業主大會卻分四個會場進行，美其名是方便居民，但以她接觸的街坊為例，不論身處東區或天水圍，仍然希望親身到大埔出席，因而認為合安是有意「打散所有居民」；而從議程上，合安亦沒納入居民關注的樓宇勘察報告、原址重建、第三輪上樓，故認為合安只為滿足土地審裁署早前裁定必須要開業主大會的要求，「根本唔可能係咁樣開會，同埋大埔會場亦都好細，其實全香港一定有會場係容納到千幾人。」', 'target': "Ms. Ho also believes that Hop On is calling the owners' meeting but splitting it into four venues under the pretext of convenience for residents. However, taking the neighbors she has contacted as an example, whether they are in the Eastern District or Tin Shui Wai, they still hope to attend in person at Tai Po. Therefore, she believes Hop On is deliberately 'breaking up all the residents.' Furthermore, from the agenda, Hop On has not included the building inspection report, in-situ redevelopment, and the third round of rehousing that residents are concerned about. Therefore, she believes Hop On is merely meeting the requirement previously ruled by the Lands Tribunal that an owners' meeting must be held. 'It is simply impossible to hold a meeting like this, and the Tai Po venue is also very small. Surely in all of Hong Kong there must be a venue that can accommodate over a thousand people.'"}
